title: Structured mentions
text: The value keeps each mention as { id, label, start, end }, and the offsets follow every edit.

title: Async and abortable
text: Debounced provider calls with an AbortSignal per query; stale answers are never shown.

title: Several triggers
text: @ for people, # for tags, or any character with its own provider.

title: Plain text only
text: No HTML or contenteditable: the text is stored and rendered as text.

title: Announced
text: Result counts, no matches, and inserted mentions are announced to screen readers.
